id="faq"><div class="tool-page__container tool-page__faq-container"><div class="tool-page__section-head"><h2>Frequently Asked Questions</h2></div><div class="tool-page__faq-list"><details><summary>What is image to video AI?</summary><p>Image to video AI turns a still image into a moving video by combining the source image with instructions about motion, camera behavior, atmosphere, or story.</p></details><details><summary>How does AI image to video work?</summary><p>The model analyzes the source image, follows your creative direction, and generates motion while trying to preserve important visual details from the original image.</p></details><details><summary>How do I turn an image into a video?</summary><p>Upload an image, describe the movement or scene you want, customize the style, generate a clip, and refine it with additional feedback before exporting.</p></details><details><summary>Can I animate a photo with AI?</summary><p>Yes. Portraits, travel photos, product photos, and other supported images can be used as the starting point for an AI-generated video.</p></details><details><summary>Can I turn an illustration or artwork into a video?</summary><p>Yes. Illustrations, concept art, and other artwork can be animated by describing the movement, camera, pacing, and atmosphere you want.</p></details><details><summary>Can I use AI to animate a product image?</summary><p>Yes. Product images can become animated product visuals, advertising concepts, and social media creative. Make sure you have the rights to any uploaded asset.</p></details><details><summary>Can I control the camera movement in an AI video?</summary><p>Yes. You can describe movements such as a push-in, pan, orbit, or tracking shot in natural language. Results depend on the selected model and source image.</p></details><details><summary>Which AI model is best for image to video?</summary><p>The best model depends on your source image, desired motion, visual style, and output goal. MiniMax Design can help you explore a suitable direction for each creative brief.</p></details><details><summary>Can I edit a video after animating an image?</summary><p>Yes. Open the clip in the <a class="tool-page__heading-link" href="/tools/video-editor">AI Video Editor</a> in MiniMax Design to combine it with other footage, adjust the sequence, add captions, and prepare your finished video.</p></details></div></div></section></main><footer class="footer"><div class="page-content-frame footer__inner"><div class="footer__main"><div class="footer__brand"><div
